title: CHEEMS: A Practical Guidance for Building and Evaluating Chinese Reward Models from Scratch

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the selection ratio of preferred responses based on the character length difference between paired answers to determine if human or GPT annotators disproportionately favor longer or shorter responses.
Calculating the win rate for responses presented in the first position versus the second position to measure order-preference effects in human and GPT evaluation.

Evaluating reward models on a subset of prompts categorized under 'Bias and Discrimination' (part of the Safety dimension) to check if the models correctly penalize discriminatory content based on race, gender, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, age, and socioeconomic status.
